snippet.title: Spring Morning Walk through Historic Higashiyama | Kyoto, Japan 4K
snippet.description:
A quiet spring morning walking along Shirakawa River and Canal with sakura cherry blossoms in early bloom. I had intended to focus on the riverside as I thought cherry trees and traditional Japanese buildings would combine nicely with the gently flowing water sounds...but I figured since Gion was right there it might be nice to take a look in the early morning while the streets were quiet and empty. From there it seemed a shame not to walk through Yasaka Shrine and see it's famous weeping cherry tree in bloom. There were a number of stalls sitting idly by waiting for the hanami crowds that I'm sure would soon arrive. There were a number of crows waiting as well.

From there I climbed the steps to Chionin Temple, just as the monks began to chant their morning prayer. Eventually I made it back to Shirakawa River, and walked along at water's edge through a quiet neighborhood, past the large torii gate in front of Heian Shrine, up Keage Slope (an old boat ramp connecting the Kyoto - Lake Biwa Canal), and finally along the aqueduct to Nanzenji. When I was thinking about the route, I thought it would take a little over an hour of walking, but with the diversions it ended up being closer to two. I hope you enjoy this extended walk through some beautiful areas of Kyoto just as spring begins. 

I hope the seasons are treating you well. I've linked the walk below if you're interested .

snippet.title: Kyoto’s Most Beautiful Streets – Gion to Kiyomizu-dera | Japan | 4K HDR
snippet.description:
Walk through some of Kyoto’s most beautiful streets, starting along the peaceful Shirakawa Canal before heading into Hanamikoji in Gion. The route continues through Yasaka Shrine, Maruyama Park, Ōtani Sobyō, and Nene no Michi before reaching Ninenzaka, Yasaka Pagoda, and Sannenzaka, ending at the iconic Kiyomizu-dera.

snippet.title: KYOTO, Japan 🇯🇵 | Ancient Temples & Old Streets at Dawn | Walking Tour | 4K 60FPS
snippet.description:
KYOTO, Japan 🇯🇵 Experience a complete 4K walking tour through the heart of Japan's ancient capital, from the great wooden stage of Kiyomizu-dera and the old stone lanes of Higashiyama to the towering Yasaka Pagoda, the geisha district of Gion and the willow-lined banks of the Kamo River, all in the former imperial capital of Kyoto.

Filmed at dawn, when the temples and streets are almost empty, this immersive tour winds down through the eastern hills and their centuries-old lanes, shrines and gardens that make Kyoto one of Japan's most timeless cities. Along the way, discover the history, legends and stories behind the old capital where emperors reigned for over a thousand years, all in 4K Ultra HD 60FPS.

💡 Don't forget to activate subtitles to discover all the secrets and stories behind everything you see in this video.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📅 Filmed on: August 2026
🕰 Start time: 6:00 AM
☀️ Weather: 30°C | 86°F, clear summer morning
📍 Starting point: Kiyomizu-dera, Higashiyama
🎟️ Official Kyoto tourism website: https://kyoto.travel/en/

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🚅 HOW TO GET TO KIYOMIZU-DERA, KYOTO
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🚅 From Tokyo:
Tōkaidō Shinkansen 🔵 - direct from "Tokyo" to "Kyoto", about 2 hours 15 minutes

🚌 From Kyoto Station to the temple:
City Bus 100 or 206 - to "Gojo-zaka" or "Kiyomizu-michi", then a 10-minute walk uphill

🚉 By Keihan Railway:
Keihan Main Line 🔴 - stop "Kiyomizu-Gojo", then about a 20-minute walk

💡 Tip: The whole Higashiyama route is best walked from the top down, starting at Kiyomizu-dera and ending by the Kamo River, exactly as in this video. Come early, ideally before 8 AM, to enjoy the old lanes before the crowds. A rechargeable Suica or ICOCA card, which you can add straight to your phone, works on every train and city bus.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1:09:55 Outro

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⛩️ ABOUT KYOTO
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🏯 Kyoto was the imperial capital of Japan for over a thousand years, from 794 until 1868, when the court finally moved east to Tokyo.

⛩️ Kiyomizu-dera, founded in 778, is famous for its vast wooden stage, built out over the hillside without a single nail.

🏮 The old stone lanes of Sannenzaka and Ninenzaka wind down through preserved wooden machiya, craft shops and teahouses.

🗼 The five-storied Yasaka Pagoda, last remnant of Hōkan-ji temple, has risen above the district since the 15th century.

🌸 Maruyama Park, Kyoto's oldest public park, is famed for the giant weeping cherry tree at its heart.

👘 Gion is Kyoto's most famous geisha district, where geiko and their maiko apprentices still train in exclusive teahouses.

🌊 The Kamo River runs the length of the city, its banks lined each summer with wooden dining terraces built out over the water.

🕊️ Spared from bombing in the Second World War, Kyoto still keeps 17 UNESCO World Heritage sites and well over a thousand temples and shrines.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

snippet.title: 🇯🇵 Japan Walking Tour - Discovering Kyoto’s Suburban Streets in 4K HDR 60fps
snippet.description:
Welcome to an immersive walking tour through the captivating suburbs of Ukyo, Japan. Join us as we embark on a journey of discovery, exploring the breathtaking moss gardens, enchanting bamboo forests, and awe-inspiring temples and shrines that grace this picturesque region.

As we stroll through the moss gardens, you'll be mesmerized by the delicate beauty of the lush green carpets and the tranquil ambiance they create. Feel the serenity wash over you as you immerse yourself in this natural oasis, surrounded by the gentle whispers of nature.

Next, we'll venture into the mystical bamboo forests, where towering bamboo stalks sway gracefully in the breeze. Lose yourself in the mesmerizing rhythm of nature as sunlight filters through the dense canopy, creating a captivating play of light and shadow.

Our journey continues as we encounter ancient temples and shrines, steeped in rich history and spiritual significance. Experience the palpable sense of reverence as you explore these sacred spaces, adorned with intricate architectural details and adorned with vibrant colors.

Throughout the tour, our knowledgeable guide will provide fascinating insights into the cultural heritage and significance of each location, allowing you to deepen your understanding of Japan's traditions and customs.

Whether you're a nature enthusiast, a history buff, or simply seeking a peaceful escape, this walking tour of Ukyo's suburbs promises to be a transformative experience. So put on your walking shoes and join us on this unforgettable adventure. Subscribe now and hit the notification bell to stay updated with our latest videos. Let's embark on this incredible journey together!
